# requires: wire
# A host binding never authorizes sending a credential over plain HTTP.
credential hf 127.0.0.1
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:gated cred=hf
run A alpha
state A

# expect 3: transfer-failed state=failed ... [DL-K5]
# expect 3: done=0 err=set ... [DL-K5]
# expect 4: ok state=failed ... [DL-K5]
